Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, VirtualView, VirtualViewRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualViewRmi, VirtualServer
Client-side RMI endpoint, playing two roles at once:
  1. Server proxy (VirtualServer): the client calls joinGame(int, String), placeTotem(String, char), and takeCard(String, String) on this object, which forward to the remote VirtualServerRmi stub looked up in the RMI registry.
  2. Remote callback target (VirtualViewRmi): by extending UnicastRemoteObject, this instance is itself exported as a remote object, so the server can invoke showGameDelta(GameDelta), showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot), and reportError(String) on it to push updates.

On construction, a background heartbeat thread is started (see startHeartbeat()), which periodically pings the server to detect a crash and, if one occurs, starts a reconnect watcher that polls the RMI registry until the server comes back online.

    • RmiClient

      public RmiClient(String host, int port, ClientModel model) throws RemoteException, NotBoundException
      Looks up the "MesosServer" remote object in the RMI registry at host:port, exports this client as a remote object, and starts the heartbeat thread.
      Parameters:
      host - the hostname or IP address of the RMI registry
      port - the port of the RMI registry
      model - the local client model that callback methods will update
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if exporting this object or contacting the registry fails
      NotBoundException - if no object named "MesosServer" is bound in the registry

    • joinGame

      public void joinGame(int numPlayers, String nickname) throws Exception
      Sends a request to join or create a game with the given number of players.

      Before joining, registers this client's remote callback object with the server via VirtualServerRmi.connect(String, VirtualViewRmi), so that subsequent notifications can be pushed back to it.

      Specified by:
      joinGame in interface VirtualServer
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the desired game size
      nickname - the player's chosen display name
      Throws:
      Exception - if the request cannot be sent (transport failure) or is rejected by the server (game-rule violation)

      public void showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot snapshot) throws RemoteException
      Pushes a full game snapshot to this client, replacing its local state entirely.

      Used both when a game starts (broadcast to all players) and when a player reconnects after a server crash (sent individually).

      Invoked remotely by the server. Delegates to ClientModel.setInitialState(GameSnapshot).

    • ping

      public void ping() throws RemoteException
      No-op method used as a liveness probe.

      If the client is reachable, this call returns normally; if the client process has crashed or is unreachable, RMI raises a RemoteException, which the caller's heartbeat mechanism interprets as a client disconnection.

      No-op: the mere fact that this remote call succeeds tells the server's RmiViewAdapter heartbeat that this client is still alive.

      Specified by:
      ping in interface VirtualViewRmi
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the client is unreachable
